task: Implement the UI for cloning an MCP server configuration (clone action, permission gating, copy-values dialog, store method, edit-view redirect, stripped-fields/warning banners, error handling) consuming an existing backend clone endpoint.

key_reasoning.reason: Touches mcpStore (new cloneConfig method), useMCPManagement hook (new state/handlers), MCPServerActions.tsx and MCPServerModal/index.tsx (modified), plus a brand-new MCPCopyValuesDialog component and types/entity/mcp.ts — 5+ components across store, hook, UI, and types, with a genuinely new abstraction (masked-value preview+reveal dialog) that has no precedent in the codebase.

Acceptance criteria enumerate the pieces clearly, but several design decisions are open: what counts as a 'sensitive key', the masked-preview+reveal interaction model, and exact wording/placement of the stripped-fields and placeholder_value_present warnings — all left to be designed from scratch.

No existing masked-value/reveal UI pattern anywhere in the repo for the copy-values dialog; toaster-based error surfacing is not currently wired for this family of store mutations (only console.error/mcpStore.error today), so 'clear error via toaster' is new UX plumbing, not a drop-in reuse. Permission gating and the create/update store pattern do have direct precedent (BudgetsManagementPage, mcpStore mutators), which keeps this at L rather than XL.

Estimated: mcp.ts (store), useMCPManagement.ts (hook), MCPServerActions.tsx, MCPServerModal/index.tsx, columnRenderers.tsx (modified, ~5); new MCPCopyValuesDialog component + co-located hook, plus store/menu test files (new, ~3); spanning src/store, src/pages/settings/administration (hooks/components), and src/types — 3+ directories.
